cases.name: child process credential validation is public and int32 bounded
cases.source: import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; function main(): void { const invalid: any[] = ['123', true, new Number(1), 1.5, NaN, Infinity, -2147483649, 2147483648]; for (const field of ['uid', 'gid']) for (const value of invalid) { let caught: any; try { spawnSync('/__thaw_process_credentials_missing__', { [field]: value }); } catch (error) { caught = error; } if (!(caught instanceof TypeError) || caught.code !== 'ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE' || !caught.message.includes('options.' + field)) throw new Error('invalid ' + field + ' must throw TypeError/ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE'); } const accepted = [0, 123, -1, -2147483648, 2147483647]; for (const field of ['uid', 'gid']) for (const value of accepted) { let result: any; try { result = spawnSync('/__thaw_process_credentials_missing__', { [field]: value }); } catch (error) { throw new Error('accepted ' + field + ' threw during public validation: ' + error); } if (!result || !result.error) throw new Error('missing executable should fail finitely after accepted validation'); } for (const field of ['uid', 'gid']) for (const value of [null, undefined]) { const result: any = spawnSync('/__thaw_process_credentials_missing__', { [field]: value }); if (!result.error || result.error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw new Error('nullish ' + field + ' must be omitted before ordinary ENOENT startup failure'); } console.log('public credential validation ok'); }

cases.name: child process callback and promisified startup failures complete once
cases.source: import { execFile } from 'node:child_process'; import { promisify } from 'node:util'; async function main(): Promise<void> { let callbackCount = 0; await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => { execFile('/__thaw_process_credentials_missing__', { uid: null }, (error, stdout, stderr) => { callbackCount++; if (!error || error.code !== 'ENOENT' || stdout !== '' || stderr !== '') { reject(new Error('execFile did not preserve finite ENOENT startup failure')); return; } resolve(); }); }); if (callbackCount !== 1) throw new Error('execFile callback must complete once'); let promiseError: any; try { await promisify(execFile)('/__thaw_process_credentials_missing__', { gid: undefined }); } catch (error) { promiseError = error; } if (!promiseError || promiseError.code !== 'ENOENT' || promiseError.stdout !== '' || promiseError.stderr !== '') throw new Error('promisified execFile did not preserve finite ENOENT startup failure'); console.log('startup failure completion ok'); }
